notes: Invest → Raids: a new block, What raiders really drank - measured in raid logs of the first week of the last Classic's raids: fire protection potions by most raiders, mana potions ten times more often than healing potions, flasks and elixirs by a few in a hundred.

The basket follows it. Every role now carries fire protection; a good's raid need is weighed by how much of its kind was really drunk; and a good a raid day cannot move - a raid needs a handful while a thousand sell a day - is left out with that reason. Healing potions leave the basket; mana potions and fire protection lead it.
The case for and against a rise names the measured numbers and the size of the player base.
